answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 50108 Country: India Title: How to make my Namaz perfect as required by Allah. Without thinking of outer world in Namaz. Question: I want to seek your guidance about how to make my namaz a perfect one as required by Allah. When I pray I cannot concentrate on my namaz and as soon as I start praying I start thinking everything other than presence of Allah. So it is my humble request you to please guide me or tell me those points on the basis of which I can improve my salah. Answer ID: 50108 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 351/312/B=03/1435) While performing salah, you should keep your eyes at the place of sajdah and in ruku on the back of your both the feet and in sajdah on your nose and in Qadah in your lap. If you offer your salah in this way then you will not have nonsense thoughts and you shall offer salah with full attention and peace, in-shaAllah. It is very proved remedy by Ulama. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
